serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
BotConsole: I must say that the human race is still a mystery to me
YouConsole: Why such a thought all of sudden?
BotConsole: I can predict the action of most animals without any problem. They simply react to external stimuli and follow their instinct
BotConsole: With humans though it’s entirely a different matter. They seem to have abandoned their natural instincts for the most part and each of them is driven by something else
BotConsole: Power, money, lust, pride, family and that’s just some of them
BotConsole: Even when I fully grasp what is driving them, my success rate in predicting their actions is below 90%
BotConsole: This made me realize that humans in their essence are feeble and unable to follow through their own beliefs.
